definition.name: NXxas_trans
definition.doc:
In transmission, the linear attenuation coefficient or absorption coefficient :math:`\mu(E)` is given by the Beer-Lambert law:
.. math:: \mu(E)t = -\ln(I/I_0)
where :math:`I` is the intensity of the transmitted beam, :math:`I_0` is the intensity of the incident beam, and :math:`t` is the thickness of the sample.
The top-level :ref:`intensity </NXxas/ENTRY/intensity-field>` field contains the processed absorbance. When the raw detector data and processing steps are available, they can be stored in the optional ``NXinstrument``, ``NXcollection``, and ``NXprocess`` groups, enabling full reproducibility of the data reduction.

field.name: definition
field.doc: Official NeXus NXDL schema to which this file conforms.

field.name: intensity
field.doc: The absorbance :math:`\mu(E)t = -\ln(I/I_0)`, the product of the absorption coefficient :math:`\mu(E)` and the sample thickness :math:`t`.

dimensions.doc: ``dataRank`` is 1 for a single spectrum, shape ``[nEnergy]``, or 2 for a stack of ``nP`` spectra, shape ``[nP, nEnergy]``.

group.doc: The ``data`` field of each detector below holds the intensity used to compute the absorbance and may already include corrections. If the uncorrected values are kept, they are archived in the ``NXcollection`` group and the corrections are described in ``NXprocess``.

field.name: d_spacing
field.doc: The spacing between crystal planes of the reflection

field.name: type
field.doc: Type or material of monochromating substance (Si, Ge, Multilayer).

field.name: reflection
field.doc: Miller indices (hkl) values of nominal reflection

group.name: i0
group.doc: Detector measuring the incident beam intensity :math:`I_0`.

dimensions.doc: ``dataRank`` is 1 for a single spectrum, shape ``[nEnergy]``, or 2 for a stack of ``nP`` spectra, shape ``[nP, nEnergy]``.

group.name: itrans
group.doc: Detector measuring the transmitted beam intensity :math:`I`.

dimensions.doc: ``dataRank`` is 1 for a single spectrum, shape ``[nEnergy]``, or 2 for a stack of ``nP`` spectra, shape ``[nP, nEnergy]``.

group.name: iref
group.doc: Detector measuring the reference intensity :math:`I_{ref}`, placed after a reference sample (typically a metal foil). For a reference that is an independent spectrum probing a different absorbing element or absorption edge, use the ``reference`` subentry instead.

dimensions.doc: ``dataRank`` is 1 for a single spectrum, shape ``[nEnergy]``, or 2 for a stack of ``nP`` spectra, shape ``[nP, nEnergy]``.

group.name: reference
group.doc:
An independent reference spectrum, for example a metal-foil standard used for energy calibration. Use this group instead of the ``iref`` detector when the reference is a complete spectrum in its own right, in particular when it probes a different absorbing element or absorption edge, so that the element, edge, energy axis, and intensity of the reference can be described in full.
Provide the ``iref`` detector when the reference is a simultaneous transmission channel that shares the main energy axis. Provide this ``reference`` subentry when the reference is an independent measurement. Do not provide both for the same reference.

field.name: definition
field.doc: Official NeXus NXDL schema to which this subentry conforms. Should be an ``NXxas``-family definition (for example ``NXxas`` or ``NXxas_trans``).

group.doc: Raw data as written by the acquisition software, preserved without modification to allow independent reprocessing.

Description of how :ref:`intensity </NXxas/ENTRY/intensity-field>` was obtained from the raw detector data (i0, itrans, and iref). When present, it allows a third party to fully reproduce the data reduction.

field.name: program
field.doc: Name of the program used for processing.

field.name: version
field.doc: Version of the program used for processing.

field.name: sequence_index
field.doc: Order of this step when several NXprocess groups describe a sequence of corrections.

group.name: parameters
group.doc: Validated parameters of the corrections applied, for example energy calibration, deglitching, incident-beam normalization, or scan merging. Each parameter should carry a units attribute where applicable.

group.name: note
group.doc: Code or notes reproducing the top-level :ref:`intensity </NXxas/ENTRY/intensity-field>` from the raw data.

field.name: type
field.doc: Mime content type of the note data field.
